body:
This PR checks the path in `sort_by_creation_time` before sorting by creation time. If a file does not exist, then a `StatStruct` of all zeros is made. This meant the the sort never actually happen.

To be merged before https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaCoupler.jl/pull/2159, since with this PR merged, this will cause an error in restarting in ClimaCoupler.

Related PR: https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaCoupler.jl/pull/2159

I asked a LLM to make these changes.
title: Check paths in sort_by_creation_time
